data.title: Air Force uses robotics to create part for damaged C-17
data.description: When Boeing couldn’t provide a replacement part for a storm-damaged C-17 Globemaster III, the Air Force turned to its own robots to make a new one.
data.author: Gary Warner
data.keywords: air force robotics replacement part c-17, air force C-17 Globemaster III, air force c-17, 445th Airlift Wing, Air Force Rapid Sustainment Office
